scope: Source-backed identity conflicts and umbrella-name ambiguities that must block canonical promotion until proposition-level review resolves them.

grapegen06-petit-verdot-cross-country-co.notes: GrapeGen06 registers the literal name Petit Verdot under VIVC 12973 (VERDOT NOIR) in Switzerland and under VIVC 12974 (VERDOT PETIT) in several other national catalogues. A country-free Adelaide row therefore cannot be promoted safely without reconciliation.

grapegen06-catarratto-umbrella-2026-09-0.notes: GrapeGen06 maps Maltese Catarratto and the Italian compound registered row Catarratto bianco comune / Catarratto bianco lucido to CATARRATTO BIANCO COMUNE, VIVC 2341. The Adelaide literal Catarratto Bianco is less specific than the registered proposition and is kept quarantined pending subtype/source reconciliation.
